species: T cell receptor (TCR) stimulation with either CD3 ligation in T cells from C57BL/6 mice
tissue: Unstimulated CD3+ TN cells and CD4+ OT-II TN cells were directly washed with PBS and lysed in the IP lysis buffer following their isolation from spleens.
cell_type: we performed liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis on Sirt2-immunoprecipitated proteins from CD3+ T cells.
disease_state: we performed LC-MS/MS analysis on acetyl-lysine (AcK)-immunoprecipitated proteins from WT vs. Sirt2−/− CD3+ T cells.
sample_source: T cell receptor (TCR) stimulation with either CD3 ligation in T cells from C57BL/6 mice
age: Mice were used at 7–8 weeks of age with age- and sex-matched controls.
strain: C57BL/6J mice, Pmel mice with gp100-reactive TCR: B6.Cg-Thy1a/Cy Tg(TcraTcrb)8Rest/J, OT-II mice with MHC II-restricted OVA-specific TCR: B6.Cg-Tg(TcraTcrb)425Cbn/J, Sirt2−/− mice: B6.129-Sirt2tm1.1Fwa/J and NSG mice: NOD.Cg-Prkdcscid Il2rgtm1Wjl/SzJ were purchased from The Jackson Laboratory.
